method: Queried NASA POWER daily point API (T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, 2024-01-01..05) on both sides of each predicted MERRA-2 cell edge and compared the returned values with the Virú demo point (-8.42, -78.75).
conclusion: Consistent with the MERRA-2 grid of 0.5 deg latitude x 0.625 deg longitude (cell centred at -8.5, -78.75), verified to 0.01 deg at this location.
